issue: A stale first menu can land while the second open is waiting on its world read; the second open is then refused and removes the current session, so the visible menu's loot page never receives the chance-ready refresh.
scenario: Hold menu opens, call open for the same player twice with the second loadedWorlds held, release the first menu open, then complete the second world read. The second openTracked uses the epoch captured before the first menu landed, returns empty, and sessions.remove removes the second session; the visible first menu is no longer registered, so clicking its loot leaves the page calculating after chances publish.
basis: Round 4's request-version tracking is meant to keep the current wiki session registered across stale opens; its own race test covers an older world read being ignored, but the inverse stale menu open still drops the current session.
